interfaces.live_synthetic_scope: TESTED public CLI with synthetic driver/dry/watch and verified monitor API wrapper. Production driver, certificates, mounted volumes and scientific behavior remain UNTESTED.
interfaces.process_fault_injection: TESTED malformed saved invocation states and injected sampler/process failures. The unresponsive-process test intercepts both signals; it signals no OS process. Missing/failed first-sample tests replace only sampler Popen, before any monitor start.
interfaces.qualified_stop_scope: TESTED real ps and TERM against suite-created inert monitor/driver groups. Injected clock advances the 15/60-second bounds; real elapsed timeout duration is not asserted.
interfaces.receipt_residence: TESTED helper projection reads nine roles. c2v006 _terminal requires receipt inside run_dir; P112's true sibling residence needs root's c2v007. Full assembly was not called.
interfaces.receipt_residence_demonstrated: TESTED c2v006 _receipt on an inside synthetic copy and _terminal rejecting the true sibling with RECEIPT_NOT_IN_RUN_DIR. No full assembly, v003g or slots access.
interfaces.registry_theta_limitation: TESTED: _launch_registry accepts either shape-valid digest. UNTESTED: real PLAN agreement; deciding test is root's first real Phase-1 registry assembly (0782).
interfaces.resume_fixture_scope: TESTED saved interrupted states with real-format monitor records: completed/live monitor, live/reused invocation pid, mismatch, gate and mount. No actual scientific interruption was induced.
interfaces.same_k_recovery_scope: TESTED public launch after a separate synthetic invocation exits with a registered entry: first sampler ps failure, and a D7 monitor-refusal record. Both reuse the pinned entry at k=1, report ALREADY_REGISTERED_SAME_SPEC, use a new work directory and close successfully. No real scientific monitor or driver was started.
interfaces.sampler_clock_tests: TESTED with an injected clock: monitor refusal, first ps failure, 60 mounted seconds, and mount restoration. These do not claim elapsed wall-clock or production-machine sampling.
